config.moduleName: Nordic Ebony Armor and Weapons Replacer

plugin.name: 2K - recommended
plugin.description: Xtudo's all-black textures at 2K. The sensible default: it is what the set was authored around and it costs about 90 MB of VRAM less than 4K for a difference you will not see on a cuirass.

plugin.name: 4K
plugin.description: The same textures at 4K. Worth it if you take close screenshots; otherwise it is VRAM for nothing.

plugin.name: 1K
plugin.description: The same textures at 1K, for a machine that is short of VRAM.

plugin.name: With the fur collar
plugin.description: The cuirass as NordwarUA built it, with the fur mantle across the shoulders - black, from Xtudo's Full Collar Black.

plugin.name: Without the fur collar
plugin.description: NordwarUA's collarless version of the same cuirass. Nothing else changes.

installStep.name: The four weapons this cannot replace

plugin.name: Hide the ebony mace, warhammer, bow and arrows
plugin.description:
There is no wolf ebony mace, warhammer, bow or arrow - NordwarUA never made one, so those four keep the game's own look and will not match the rest of your set.
This optional light plugin takes them out of circulation: it removes them from the levelled lists they appear in and deletes their forging and tempering recipes, so a playthrough simply never offers you one. Anything already in your inventory stays.
It edits 26 vanilla levelled lists, so let it load after any levelled-list overhaul, and leave it out if you would rather keep the four items and live with the mismatch.
